desc: The Safariland Comp II Speedloader is injection molded and its push-button operation combines maximum speed with easy reloading, making it popular for duty applications. Depending on the gun, all Safariland Speedloaders may require custom grips to ensure proper clearance. Offered in four sizes for medium (K) and medium large (L) frame revolvers including Colt, Ruger and S&W models.
